questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to express surprise at a rare occurrence?
options: It was surprising to find that he had never been to London before.
Had he never been to London before, it would be surprising to find him here.
He had never been to London before; it was surprising to discover this.
To find him here, it was surprising that he had never been to London before.
questions.answer: Had he never been to London before, it would be surprising to find him here.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft construction to highlight the subject of an action?
options: The reason she left was because she found the job unfulfilling.
It was the job she found unfulfilling that led her to leave.
She left because the job was unfulfilling, and she found that out first.
The job was what she ultimately decided to abandon, as it lacked satisfaction.
questions.answer: It was the job she found unfulfilling that led her to leave.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional with the subjunctive to express hypothetical regret?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam, but I didn’t.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam, but I didn’t have the opportunity.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam, and now I regret not doing so.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam, but I didn’t have the opportunity.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of ellipsis in a formal academic context to avoid redundancy?
options: The study, which was conducted over two years, revealed significant findings.
The study revealed significant findings, which were conducted over two years.
Findings revealed in the study over two years were significant.
The research, having taken two years, concluded with significant results.
questions.answer: The study, which was conducted over two years, revealed significant findings.

questions.question: Which sentence best employs formal register and complex syntax to express a nuanced opinion?
options: While some argue that remote work has benefits, its long-term effects on team cohesion are debatable.
Although remote work has benefits, its impact on team cohesion is still being discussed.
Remote work may offer advantages, but its effects on team dynamics are not yet fully understood.
It is clear that remote work is beneficial, but the question of team cohesion remains open.
questions.answer: While some argue that remote work has benefits, its long-term effects on team cohesion are debatable.
